propositions: Atlassian Document Format (ADF) is hardwired into the Cloud path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, causing duplicate rich-text handling logic across adapters

The current two existing Cloud call paths differ in composition: backend._fit_description composes both fit and normalize steps while sanitize_description uses fit only, and collapsing them would change observable behavior

A four-operation RichTextCodec Protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) is required to preserve today's Cloud behavior and parameterize the shared map_fields_to_remote implementation across both deployments
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py, not jira_family/, to comply with J2's machine-checked import contract forbidding jira_family from importing Cloud vendor modules
No new ADF references should be introduced outside the codec layer; existing references in location-pinned outbound_fields.py and the inbound seam remain out of scope
Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in the tree under adapters/jira_family/, with the jira backend either delegating to it or not defining the method at all
